card.name: Just before approximate numbers or dates
card.fires_on: Words or digits right before a figure or date in old encyclopedia-style history text, such as 'was' or 'of' before a count, or a digit starting a measurement or time.

modes.label: Verb or 'of' before a count
modes.description: A linking word such as was, is or of sits right before a statistic or estimate.
modes.example: the average number of persons executed annually in England <<was>> 2,000.

modes.label: Digit inside a measure or time
modes.description: A digit or space inside a measurement, time or date.
modes.example: It measures about <<8>> mm. in length

modes.label: Dates and tallies in chronologies
modes.description: A marker in a dated list of events or vote tallies.

card.writes: Promotes words meaning 'about' or 'approximately' (约, 约占), so a rough quantity is expected next.
card.plain: It fires just before a number in old history or anatomy text, where an approximate figure is likely to follow.
